source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of responsible digital behaviour (PDF 188).

blocks.text: Zimmedarana digital rawayye ka matlab technology ko izzat aur hifazat se istemal karna hai: mushkil se andaza lagne wale mazboot passwords, 'password123' jaise ki bajaye harf, adad aur alamaat mila kar, aur mashkook links na daba kar aur account ki tafseel maangne wali email ki tasdeeq kar ke phishing se bachna.

blocks.explanation: (b) social media par ghalat maloomat phailana.

items: Zimmedarana rawayya: mazboot passwords, phishing se bachao, doosron ka ehtaram.
